description: Use this when the user wants a citation generator, a reference generator apa or a works cited generator for a source they type in that has no DOI or ISBN: a book, a journal article, a chapter or a web page. Give the record fields and the style, and get the formatted citation plus BibTeX, RIS and text reference-list files. Use it for a cite this for me request about an old book or a class reading. Do not use it when the user has a DOI or an ISBN, or for legal cases, patents or datasets.

keep_capitals.description: Words to keep as written, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ["Studies", "London"].

items.description: A word to preserve as supplied, e.g. Studies.

record.description: The source you type by hand when it has no DOI or ISBN.

accessed.description: Date you accessed a web page, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-17.

authors.description: Authors in the order they appear on the source, e.g. [{family:'Aspelmeyer',given:'Markus'}].

given.description: Given name or initials, e.g. Markus or M.

container.description: Journal name or book title that holds the work, e.g. Journal of Field Studies.

doi.description: DOI without the https://doi.org/ part, e.g. 10.1038/nphys1170.

keep_capitals.description: Words to keep as written, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ["Studies", "London"].

items.description: A word to preserve as supplied, e.g. Studies.

publisher.description: Publisher or site name, e.g. Example Press.

title.description: Title of the work, e.g. Measured measurement.

type.description: What kind of source it is, e.g. journal_article.

year.description: Year of publication as a whole number, e.g. 2009.

style.description: Citation style: apa7 (default), mla9, chicago_ad or chicago_nb.

name: format_manual_citation
title: Format a manual citation
